- Initial release of aerobase-jetlag skill.
- Score flights for jetlag impact on a 0-100 scale with detailed breakdowns.
- Generate personalized recovery plans based on flight and traveler details.
- Optimize departure/arrival times and provide targeted jetlag reduction strategies.
- Support for multi-leg, multi-city journey analysis with cumulative scoring.
- Premium Aerobase subscription required; free tier users have limited queries.
